svg.title: The workflow daneel brings
svg.desc: Five phases across three lanes. The owner asks, approves the batch, validates the design, publishes the release and decides the flow proposals. The agent files issues, proposes the batch, runs each task to its merge on green, ends the batch and audits it. The harness holds the backlog and the Project, checks every push and lands a PR only when all is green. The audit feeds the backlog.
svg.text: The owner decides and publishes. The agent does the work. The harness proves it.
is never a file in git
Answers the questions the agent asks before the work starts
Validates the design mocks before anything visible is built
Validates no PR: the harness does
CI on every push: lint, types, tests, E2E, coverage floors
Reviewer lanes: one review per PR, a critical fails
merge.py: lands only when all is green and graded
one task, from its branch to its merge on green
One run, a 3-hour budget; the same gate failing three times stops it.
What the audit finds becomes flow issues: the workflow improves itself
pushes a project's main · force-pushes, except the landing script pushing the task's own branch with lease · publishes a release · bypasses a hook · edits the settings that bind it
